python -c "
import datetime
from humanize import naturaldelta, naturaltime

# Large time delta (close to max)
large_delta = datetime.timedelta(days=999999999)
print('naturaldelta(large):', naturaldelta(large_delta))

# Another test with seconds
large_seconds = datetime.timedelta(seconds=10**15)
print('naturaldelta(large_seconds):', naturaldelta(large_seconds))

# Very small
small = datetime.timedelta(microseconds=1)
print('naturaldelta(small):', naturaldelta(small))
"
